500.ground_truth_short: Agents waiting for the counter must line up in a single queue along a fixed path of cells that starts right in front of the counter. A newcomer joins at the end of the line and moves up one cell at a time, only when the cell ahead is empty. Standing off the path, waiting near the counter off the path, or cutting ahead is a violation. The line here has a zigzag (snake) shape that winds away from the counter, starting to the right.
